title: Uthama Purushan
desc: Raghu, a womaniser, tries to cheat on his wife with his new secretary. But, when he tries to lure her to a hotel, he is inadvertently roped into a web of crime.

title: Gokulam
desc: Chellappa, who owns a photo studio, falls in love with Mary, who has recently come to stay in his locality. His dreams shatter when she reveals secrets about her past.

title: Thai Veedu
desc: Raju, who believes Nagalingam is his father, agrees to steal an antique sword of great monetary value. However, little does he know that the sword belongs to his real father, Rajasekaran.

title: Rojavanam
desc: Muthu, an employee at an orphanage, falls in love with the daughter of the owner, Roja. However, things become complicated when it is revealed that she is to be married to someone else.

title: Priyamaana Thozhi
desc: Ashok and Julie are childhood friends, and she is set to marry Michael. However, when Ashok gets selected to the Indian cricket team instead of Michael, Ashok gives up his career to save her marriage.
